title: Tooltipz
description: Customize your tooltips with sleek, vibrant frames. Clean, stylish, and perfectly visible.
body:
![tltpz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JP33g9Jt/images/7b73f3b467fcf15b75231b93e3116b99fdcdc17e.png) ##
A resource pack that lets you choose your tooltip frame using colors from [Tooltipz](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltipz).
By default, it displays a grey frame. Changing colors requires [Resource Pack Options](https://modrinth.com/project/TiF5QWZY). This resource pack does **not** add rarity-based tooltips. Instead, it provides a single-color frame for all items.
It also does **not** require [Tooltipz mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltipz) to function.
